fire: When the lamp burns out it can be exchanged for a new one at the shop.

Most of the town's power is drawn from a dam upriver.
You can trade your old phone for store credit.
The retiring editor will be succeeded by her deputy.
The heat in the house comes from a wood stove.
quiet: When the lamp burns out it can be thrown away with the trash.
The iron in the tablet helps the body make red blood cells.
